evals.name: model-skeleton-structure
evals.prompt: I want to add a new anomaly detection model called 'SimpleAE' (a simple autoencoder) to anomalib. What files do I need to create and where do they go?
evals.expected_output: Creates files under src/anomalib/models/image/simple_ae/: torch_model.py (nn.Module), lightning_model.py (AnomalibModule subclass), and __init__.py exporting the Lightning class.
expectations: Places model under src/anomalib/models/image/simple_ae/
Identifies torch_model.py for the nn.Module and lightning_model.py for the AnomalibModule subclass
Mentions __init__.py that exports only the Lightning class
References Padim as the minimal reference implementation to follow

evals.name: required-members
evals.prompt: What properties and methods must my AnomalibModule subclass implement? Show me the minimal skeleton.
evals.expected_output: Shows trainer_arguments property, learning_type property, training_step, validation_step, and configure_optimizers as required members on the AnomalibModule subclass.
expectations: Includes trainer_arguments property returning a dict
Includes learning_type property returning a LearningType enum value
Includes training_step accepting a Batch
Includes validation_step accepting a Batch
Includes configure_optimizers

evals.name: registration-discovery
evals.prompt: I've written my model class. How do I register it so that get_model('SimpleAE') and the CLI can find it?
evals.expected_output: Export from src/anomalib/models/image/__init__.py, add to __all__. No separate registry — get_model() discovers via AnomalibModule.__subclasses__() matching case-insensitively.
expectations: Adds export in src/anomalib/models/image/__init__.py
Updates __all__ in that file
Explains get_model() uses __subclasses__() with case-insensitive name matching
States there is no separate name-string registry to update

evals.name: test-requirements
evals.prompt: What tests do I need to add for my new anomalib model?
evals.expected_output: Add tests/unit/models/image/test_simple_ae.py testing get_model instantiation, trainer_arguments dict, learning_type enum, and synthetic batch through training_step/validation_step.
expectations: Places test under tests/unit/models/image/
Tests get_model('SimpleAE') returns the correct instance
Tests trainer_arguments and learning_type properties
Tests a synthetic batch through training_step/validation_step

evals.name: negative-no-lightning-in-torch-model
evals.prompt: Can I put my Lightning callbacks and checkpoint logic directly in torch_model.py for convenience?
evals.expected_output: No — torch_model.py must be pure PyTorch (nn.Module) without Lightning dependencies. Training side effects belong in callbacks under src/anomalib/callbacks/.
expectations: States torch_model.py must stay importable without Lightning
Explains the nn.Module forward contract (train-mode: embeddings, eval-mode: InferenceBatch)
Directs training side effects to src/anomalib/callbacks/
